summary: Second part of the network example playbook: finishes the facts file (run_once, dest /tmp/switch-facts), backs up running configs with arista.eos.eos_config and vyos.vyos.vyos_config using backup: yes and register, creates /tmp/backups/{{ inventory_hostname }} and copies each backup_path there.
questions: How do I back up a switch configuration with Ansible?
Where does eos_config backup: yes save the file?
How do I copy network config backups into a folder per host?

answer_card.title: Back up switch configs
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: Backup switch (eos)
  arista.eos.eos_config:
    backup: yes
  register: backup_eos_location
  when: ansible_network_os == 'arista.eos.eos'

- name: Copy backup into /tmp/backups/
  copy:
    src: "{{ backup_eos_location.backup_path }}"
    dest: "/tmp/backups/{{ inventory_hostname }}/{{ inventory_hostname }}.bck"
  when: ansible_network_os == 'arista.eos.eos'
```

The same pattern works for `vyos.vyos.vyos_config`. Create the destination folder first with `file: state=directory`.
